channel.title: Five Star Daily
channel.description: GTA 6 news, guides and tools. Unofficial fan site.

item.title: No, GTA 6 did not get a stutter-fix patch on November 25
item.description: A post shared widely on X since November 20 claimed Rockstar would release a GTA 6 update on November 25 to fix stuttering. PC Games Hardware checked and found no such announcement: there was no patch on that date, and Rockstar has not said when the next one is coming. The rumor had no official...

item.title: Fan-made GTA 6 PC port 'Leonida' is taken offline
item.description: GTA 6 is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but some fans are trying to force it onto PC anyway. One of those efforts, a project called Leonida that aimed to make the Xbox Series X version run on a computer, has had its GitHub page removed, VGC reports. It is also claimed that the project's Discord...

item.title: GTA 6 debuts at No. 1 on the UK retail chart, even without a disc
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI has entered the UK boxed sales chart at No. 1 in its debut week, according to the GfK-compiled ranking reported by Nintendo Life and Games Asylum. The boxed version in shops is a code in a box rather than a disc, but that did not stop it from pushing EA Sports FC 27 down to...

item.title: GTA 6 gets its first post-launch patch, rolling out in waves on PS5
item.description: Four days after launch, GTA 6 has received its first update since November 19. It is version 01.002.002 on PS5 and 1.0.2.2 on Xbox Series X|S, a download of about 603.8 MB on PlayStation and 1.6 GB on Xbox. The version and sizes were first spotted by the dataminer Tex2 and reported by VICE.On PS5...

item.title: Circana: 61% of active US PS5 players played GTA 6 on launch day
item.description: New engagement data shows how completely GTA 6 took over consoles on November 19. According to Circana's Player Engagement Tracker, shared on Bluesky by analyst Mat Piscatella, 61% of US PS5 players who were active that day played the game, as did 56% of active Xbox players worldwide. Piscatella...

item.title: Rockstar celebrates GTA 6 with a one-night festival in Miami
item.description: Two days after launch, Rockstar Games and PlayStation took GTA 6 off the screen and into the real Miami. Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival ran on Saturday, November 21, at Mana Wynwood, with two stages and a 17+ crowd. Local 10 News reported that the city came out for a night of music and Miami...

item.title: GTA 6 hides strong hints that it shares a universe with Red Dead Redemption
item.description: Players digging through Leonida have found several nods to Red Dead Redemption, and Kotaku argues they add up to real evidence of a shared universe. The clearest is a book found in Brian's marina that recounts events from Red Dead Redemption and its prequel, including the death of the outlaw Flaco...

item.title: Official: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on day one, says Take-Two
item.description: Take-Two and Rockstar have shared the first official sales figures for GTA 6. In a release dated November 20, the publisher said day-one retail sales reached $3.79 billion worldwide, based on company estimates through the end of November 19. It calls this the biggest entertainment launch in...

item.title: Take-Two's CEO laughs off GTA 7 questions on GTA 6 launch day
item.description: Asked about Grand Theft Auto 7 only hours after GTA 6 went on sale, Take-Two chief executive Strauss Zelnick politely declined to engage. Speaking on the TBPN podcast on November 19, he was asked whether a future GTA could become a live version of the whole world. His answer, as reported by...

item.title: GTA 6 passes $2 billion in estimated launch sales, per Sensor Tower
item.description: Market research firm Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 had moved more than 24.5 million copies, worth about $2.36 billion, once pre-orders and launch-day purchases are counted together, according to The Week. A day earlier, FOX 5 reported a launch-morning reading of around 19 million units and...

item.title: Rockstar makes it official: GTA 6 is out, with a rare word from Sam Houser
item.description: Rockstar Games has formally announced that Grand Theft Auto VI is available worldwide on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The press release lists the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store and retail as places to buy it, confirms an ESRB rating of M (Mature), and notes that the...

item.title: PSN hiccups as GTA 6 starts unlocking around the world
item.description: GTA 6 has started unlocking region by region, beginning with New Zealand, Australia and parts of Asia. Push Square reports scattered complaints of PlayStation Network outages over the first hours of the rollout, even though Sony's official service status page showed every service running normally...

item.title: Rockstar's launch-eve post: six regions and on-demand podcasts
item.description: On the eve of release, Rockstar published a post on the PlayStation Blog confirming that Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on PS5 on Thursday, November 19, through PlayStation Store. The post recaps the setting, the state of Leonida with Vice City at its heart, and the two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia...

item.title: GTA 6 reviews are in: Metacritic 99 on day one
item.description: Critics published their Grand Theft Auto VI reviews on the morning of November 18, one day before launch. The reaction has been close to unanimous, with Tom's Guide describing "perfect scores everywhere" in its live roundup. GamesRadar+ gave the game five stars, and PC Gamer's Chris Livingston...

item.title: Last chance for the GTA 6 Vintage Vice City Pack pre-order bonus
item.description: Standard Edition pre-orders of GTA 6 placed before November 20 include the Vintage Vice City Pack. With the game unlocking on November 19, that window closes at the end of launch day.The Standard Edition costs $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition $99.99. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said in August that...

item.title: GTA VI: The Album arrives with the game, 34 tracks
item.description: Rockstar's companion record, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, releases on November 19 alongside the game. It was made with Atlantic Records and has 34 tracks, with CD and vinyl editions, including a limited vinyl pressing.Several songs are already out as official uploads, from Travis Scott's RHYNO...

item.title: PS5 owners need a system update before playing GTA 6
item.description: PlayStation Support announced on the evening of November 17 that a PS5 system software update is required before playing Grand Theft Auto VI. Sony asked players to download it before midnight on November 19, when the game unlocks, so they are not held up at launch. Kotaku reports that Sony has not...

item.title: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19
item.description: GTA 6 does not launch at one global moment. A Rockstar support post says the game unlocks at midnight local time on November 19 in each country, so players in the Pacific and Australia get in hours before Europe and the Americas. In Australia, for example, the east coast unlocks at 12 a.m. AEDT...

item.title: GTA 6 will play on Xbox One through the cloud, but not on PC or phones
item.description: Xbox confirmed that GTA 6 joins Xbox Cloud Gaming on launch day, November 19, so it can be streamed to Xbox One as well as Xbox Series X|S. Cloud play does not cover PC, mobile or TV devices, and it runs at Xbox Series S settings, so the picture is softer than on a Series X.Microsoft did not...

item.title: What GTA 6 does on PS5 and PS5 Pro
item.description: Sony detailed the PlayStation-specific features. On PS5 the game uses the DualSense speaker, haptics and adaptive triggers, which can be adjusted in the accessibility settings, plus Tempest 3D Audio and faster loading from the SSD.On PS5 Pro it adds sharper image quality through PlayStation...

item.title: GTA 6 pre-load is live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
item.description: Rockstar opened the pre-load on November 10, nine days before launch. On PS5 it began at midnight local time; on Xbox Series X|S it began at 12 a.m. GMT worldwide.
